title: Telecom C-band single-photon sources with a semiconductor-dielectric microresonator
summary: Secure communications with quantum key distribution over fiber-optic links is one of the few recognized applications of quantum physics at the level of individual quanta -- single C-band photons. Currently, the widely used sources of such photons are highly attenuated laser pulses, featured by a low probability of single photon occurrence. Here, we present an efficient source with an InAs/GaAs quantum dot on a metamorphic buffer layer inside a micropillar-shaped microcavity.
